content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for GMCH Chandigarh Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.gmch.gov.in and click on 'VACANCIES'. Read the detailed instructions and complete the online registration before 28/10/2026 at 04:00 PM. Fill up the online application form and upload scanned copies of all required certificates, documents, and a photograph (jpeg format, not exceeding 15 KB). Pay the requisite non-refundable application fee online. Submit the application form and retain a print-out containing the Registration Number/Application ID for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28/10/2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 242 vacancies have been announced for Senior Residents, Demonstrators, Junior Residents, Medical Officers, and other posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all other categories (including General) is Rs. 500/- plus bank charges if any.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate Medical Degree (M.D./M.S./DNB/M.Ch./D.M) or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by MCI and registered with the Medical Council of India or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 28.10.2026, with age relaxations applicable for SC, OBC, Government servants, and widows/deserted women as per rules.
